_comment: Each entry is one selectable layout in the app's 'Start from a template' dropdown. JSON does not support comments, so this key is just documentation and is ignored by the app. Copy an entry, edit the fields to match a real ServiceNow notification (Subject, Message HTML/text, etc. from System Notification > Email > Notifications), and it will show up automatically.

templates.label: Beacon Onboarding (Custom Layout)
templates.subject: Welcome to Beacon – Let's get you onboarded
templates.body:
Welcome aboard! We're excited to have you join the team.

This email covers everything you need for your first week — save it somewhere handy.

Please read the whole thing before your start date; a few steps below have deadlines before day one.

HERE'S WHAT TO EXPECT THIS WEEK:

  • Accounts and system access
    • Company email and calendar
    • Slack workspace invite
  • Equipment shipment tracking details
  • Your orientation schedule
    • Monday: Welcome session
    • Wednesday: Benefits walkthrough

A FEW QUICK STEPS TO COMPLETE BEFORE DAY ONE:

  1. Confirm your start date with your manager
  2. Complete your I-9 and tax forms in the portal
    1. Federal W-4
    2. State tax form
  3. Set up your laptop using the instructions we sent separately

If anything looks off or you have questions, reach out to your onboarding buddy or visit the Onboarding Portal.

Welcome again,
The Beacon Team

ONBOARDING
